arStrings.szText: He's taken Tyrael! Buried him alive in the Fractured Peaks! The location was marked on a map. An obvious trap, but I have no choice! I've lost everyone else, I won't lose Tyrael too.
He's taken Tyrael! Buried him alive in the Fractured Peaks! The location was marked on a map. An obvious trap, but I have no choice! I've lost everyone else, I won't lose Tyrael too.
It seems we've averted disaster. Tyrael is alive, but clearly shaken. I should go to him in Gea Kul and make sure he's well. Or at least well enough after all of this.
